The Metanoia Method

More than a training program.

Choosing

Which path suits you?

In person

Best suited to someone who:

  • Wants hands-on exercise coaching
  • Values face-to-face accountability
  • Wants help developing confidence in the gym
  • Wants immediate feedback on technique
  • Prefers scheduled personal training

Online

Best suited to someone who:

  • Is comfortable training independently
  • Wants ongoing support throughout the week
  • Values structured accountability
  • Wants nutritional guidance
  • Wants regular communication with their coach
  • Wants a complete personalised training system

Online coaching is not a cheaper version of personal training. They are different services offering different levels and forms of support.

The System

A program gives you exercises. A system changes how you operate.

Philosophy

Confidence is built through evidence.

  • Every session completed.
  • Every promise kept.
  • Every improvement made.
  • Every difficult day you still showed up.

Transformation is not something a coach can do for you. Our role is to provide the structure, knowledge and support that helps you do the work.
